title: Track guide Okayama Short Ray FF1600 - Fixed iRacing

corners.label: T1
corners.braking: brake hard at tire marks, trail brake to apex
corners.line: turn-in left, apex at brown patch, track out
corners.exit: full throttle, use all track, take curb
corners.mistakes: don't go off track with curb

corners.label: T2
corners.braking: brake to 50% at white line, trail brake to middle
corners.line: wider entry, turn-in towards curb, apex on curb
corners.exit: full throttle, take all curb, steer into next curve
corners.mistakes: don't go too close to first curb, avoid spinning off curb

corners.braking: Break just before the fins on the outside, quick tap to 25%
corners.line: Apex in the second half of the curb
corners.exit: Go on throttle, open steering, use outside curb
corners.mistakes: Taking too much curb can cause a spin

corners.braking: Brake on green astro turf, peak 60%
corners.line: Apex in the middle of the turn, on the curb
corners.exit: Full throttle, use all of the curb
corners.mistakes: Cutting curb too much will unsettle the car
